title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
statement_md:
Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2, return the median of the two sorted arrays combined. The overall run time complexity should be O(log(m + n)).

### Input and Output
Your code is a function `solution`. Return the value exactly as expected; the judge compares with strict equality.

### Examples
**Example 1:**
```
Median of Two Sorted Arrays([1,3], [2]) -> 2
```

**Example 2:**
```
Median of Two Sorted Arrays([1,2], [3,4]) -> 2.5
```
concept_md: Median splits the merged array into equal halves, so binary-search the split point in the smaller array while the other split follows arithmetically. Recognise it for 'find the k-th element in two sorted arrays'.
hints: Don't merge; a median only needs the separating boundary between the two halves.
Binary-search the split in the smaller array — the split in the other array is forced by the half-size condition.
i in a, j=(total+1)/2 - i; valid when a[i-1]<=b[j] and b[j-1]<=a[i]; else move i
